'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Angelo Consoli LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name QMC. Unread reserve lines: 42. No wiki dest: Gola.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' DrevithShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
